features.name: Page Load Time Optimization
features.description: Ensure all pages load within 2.5 seconds under normal network conditions with specific targets for different page types

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user of the car rental platform, I want fast, responsive interactions throughout my journey, so that I can complete bookings efficiently without frustration or abandonment.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page loads in ≤ 2.0 seconds
Vehicle search results page loads in ≤ 2.5 seconds
Vehicle details page loads in ≤ 2.0 seconds
Booking flow pages load in ≤ 2.0 seconds
User account pages load in ≤ 1.5 seconds
Admin dashboard loads in ≤ 3.0 seconds

features.name: API Response Time Requirements
features.description: Ensure API requests return responses within specified time limits based on operation complexity

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want API operations to complete quickly so that the application feels responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Vehicle search queries return results in ≤ 500 milliseconds
Availability checks complete in ≤ 300 milliseconds
Booking creation completes in ≤ 1.5 seconds
Payment processing completes in ≤ 3.0 seconds
User authentication completes in ≤ 500 milliseconds
Profile updates complete in ≤ 800 milliseconds

features.name: Real-Time Updates Performance
features.description: Update user interface within 2 seconds when vehicle availability or pricing changes without requiring page refresh

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want to see availability and pricing changes in real-time without refreshing the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Availability changes reflect in search results within 2 seconds
Price updates display within 2 seconds
Booking status changes appear within 2 seconds
Fleet status updates (admin) appear within 3 seconds
Real-time notifications deliver within 1 second

features.name: Interactive Response Feedback
features.description: Provide immediate visual feedback within 100 milliseconds for all UI interactions

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want immediate feedback when I interact with UI elements so I know my actions are registered.
acceptanceCriteria: Button clicks show visual state change in ≤ 100ms
Form field validation displays in ≤ 200ms
Filter applications show loading state in ≤ 100ms
Dropdown menus open in ≤ 100ms
Modal dialogs appear in ≤ 150ms

features.name: Concurrent User Support
features.description: Support at least 1,000 concurrent users performing typical operations without performance degradation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want the system to handle many concurrent users without slowdowns.
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains response time requirements with 1,000 concurrent users
Search operations handle 100 requests per second
Booking operations handle 20 requests per second
Payment operations handle 10 requests per second
Admin operations handle 50 requests per second

features.name: Peak Load Handling with Graceful Degradation
features.description: Maintain core functionality with graceful degradation of non-critical features during 3x normal load

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user during peak times, I want core booking features to remain functional even if some features are temporarily unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Core booking flow remains functional at 3x normal load
Response times may increase by up to 50% during peaks
Non-critical features (recommendations, analytics) may be temporarily disabled
System provides clear feedback about temporary limitations
No data loss or corruption occurs during peak loads

features.name: Search Query Performance Optimization
features.description: Return vehicle search results within 500 milliseconds for queries returning up to 1,000 vehicles with multiple filters

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user searching for vehicles, I want fast search results even with multiple filters applied.
acceptanceCriteria: Simple searches (location + dates) complete in ≤ 300ms
Filtered searches (+ vehicle type, price range) complete in ≤ 500ms
Complex searches (+ multiple features, sorting) complete in ≤ 800ms
Pagination of results occurs instantly (client-side)
Filter updates reflect in ≤ 200ms

features.name: Database Query Optimization
features.description: Optimize database queries to complete within specified time limits with proper indexing and query planning

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want efficient database queries to ensure fast response times.
acceptanceCriteria: No single query executes for more than 2 seconds
Database connection pool maintains at least 20 available connections
Query result sets are paginated for large data sets
Indexes exist on all frequently queried fields
Query execution plans are reviewed and optimized quarterly

features.name: Memory Management
features.description: Manage memory efficiently to prevent leaks and ensure stable long-term operation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want stable memory usage to prevent crashes and performance degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: Application memory usage remains stable over 24-hour periods
Memory leaks are detected and fixed before production deployment
Garbage collection pauses do not exceed 100ms
Cache sizes are bounded with appropriate eviction policies
Memory usage per user session does not exceed 10MB

features.name: Network Bandwidth Optimization
features.description: Minimize network bandwidth usage through compression, modern formats, and CDN delivery

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user on a slower connection, I want optimized content delivery so pages load quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Images are compressed and served in modern formats (WebP, AVIF)
JavaScript and CSS are minified and bundled
Gzip or Brotli compression is enabled for text resources
CDN is used for static assets
Initial page load transfers ≤ 2MB of data
Subsequent page loads transfer ≤ 500KB of data

features.name: Mobile-First Performance
features.description: Deliver optimized performance for mobile devices with appropriate load times for 3G and 4G/5G connections

requirementDetails.userStory: As a mobile user, I want fast page loads even on slower mobile connections.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile pages load in ≤ 3.0 seconds on 3G connections
Mobile pages load in ≤ 1.5 seconds on 4G/5G connections
Touch interactions respond within 100ms
Scrolling maintains 60 frames per second
Mobile app (if applicable) launches in ≤ 2 seconds

features.name: Progressive Web App Performance
features.description: Provide near-native performance and offline functionality through PWA capabilities with service worker caching

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want app-like performance with offline access to key features.
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker caches critical resources for offline access
Cached pages load in ≤ 500ms
Offline functionality includes viewing reservations and digital keys
Background sync queues actions when offline
App shell loads instantly on repeat visits

features.name: Serverless Scaling for Variable Workloads
features.description: Implement serverless architecture for specific functions to scale automatically to handle demand spikes

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want cost-effective scaling for variable workloads like pricing calculations.
acceptanceCriteria: Serverless functions (e.g., pricing calculations) scale to handle 10x normal load
Cold start times for serverless functions do not exceed 1 second
Serverless functions execute within allocated memory limits
Cost per invocation remains within budget thresholds
Monitoring tracks serverless function performance and errors

features.name: Edge Computing and CDN
features.description: Serve content from geographically distributed edge locations to minimize latency

requirementDetails.userStory: As a global user, I want content served from nearby locations for faster load times.
acceptanceCriteria: Static assets are served from CDN edge locations
API responses are cached at edge where appropriate
Edge locations exist in all major geographic markets
Cache hit rates exceed 80% for static content
Edge-to-origin latency does not exceed 100ms

features.name: Microservices Performance Management
features.description: Ensure inter-service communication in microservices architecture does not create unacceptable latency

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with microservices, I want efficient inter-service communication.
acceptanceCriteria: Service-to-service calls complete in ≤ 50ms (same data center)
Service-to-service calls complete in ≤ 200ms (cross-region)
Circuit breakers prevent cascading failures
Service mesh provides observability into inter-service performance
Asynchronous messaging is used for non-critical operations

features.name: Real-Time Performance Monitoring
features.description: Continuously monitor performance metrics and alert operators when thresholds are exceeded

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want real-time performance monitoring to detect issues quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tracks all critical transactions
Real-time dashboards display current performance metrics
Alerts trigger when response times exceed thresholds by 20%
Alerts trigger when error rates exceed 1%
Performance data is retained for at least 90 days for analysis

features.name: Performance Testing Requirements
features.description: Conduct performance testing for new features to verify requirements are met before deployment

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want performance testing to prevent regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Load testing simulates expected concurrent user loads
Stress testing identifies breaking points
Endurance testing runs for at least 24 hours
Performance regression tests run with each deployment
Performance test results are documented and reviewed

features.name: Multi-Layer Caching Strategy
features.description: Implement multi-layer caching (browser, CDN, application, database) to reduce load and improve response times

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want effective caching to improve performance and reduce costs.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser caching is configured for static assets (1 year)
CDN caching is configured for images and media (1 month)
Application-level caching stores frequently accessed data (Redis/Memcached)
Database query results are cached where appropriate
Cache invalidation strategies prevent stale data

features.name: Asynchronous Processing
features.description: Process non-immediate operations asynchronously to improve perceived performance

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want long-running operations to not block my interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Email notifications are sent asynchronously
Report generation occurs in background jobs
Image processing happens asynchronously
Analytics data is processed in batches
Users receive immediate feedback with status updates for async operations

features.name: Database Performance Optimization
features.description: Optimize database performance through indexing, query optimization, and appropriate data modeling

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want optimized database performance to support fast queries.
acceptanceCriteria: All foreign keys have indexes
Frequently queried fields have appropriate indexes
Composite indexes exist for common multi-field queries
Database statistics are updated regularly
Slow query logs are monitored and addressed
